blockers.detail: process startup order: CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores() and InitProcess() must precede BaseInit(); BaseInit() no longer creates shared memory
H0 FuzzerInitialize calls BaseInit(); InitProcess(); without creating shared memory

rationale.zh: M 统一进程启动顺序：BaseInit() 不再调用 InitCommunication()/CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores()，要求先建共享内存、InitProcess() 再 BaseInit()。H0 的 FuzzerInitialize 仍按旧顺序 BaseInit(); InitProcess();，共享内存从未创建，InitProcess 直接 PANIC 中止。S0 正常，本次引入。H 的提交标题直接引用 Postgres commit b406478b，把顺序改为 CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(); InitProcess(); BaseInit();。
rationale.en: M unifies the process startup order: BaseInit() no longer calls InitCommunication()/CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(), so callers must create shared memory and call InitProcess() before BaseInit(). FuzzerInitialize in the harness H0 still calls BaseInit(); InitProcess(); in the old order, shared memory is never created, and InitProcess() aborts with PANIC. The same harness works with S0 (M^1), so the degradation is introduced by this change. The title of the fix H cites Postgres commit b406478b; it changes the order to CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(); InitProcess(); BaseInit();.
